text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year. As I was walking through the 
school grounds on some business—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf is finally making her debut this 
year, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, the turf is going to look so 
gorgeous. I'm so, so excited!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I saw Mr. C.B. and her friends relaxing 
in the cafeteria."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But my debut is still several 
months away. It's a bit premature for a 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A few months will fly by in no time! 
Rudolf, you're already totally prepared, 
right? Both your dreams and your skills!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is giving me far too much 
credit, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Only the ambition is fully prepared, while 
the actual ability hasn't kept up at all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, Rudolf's dream was... 
to bring happiness to all Umamusume, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I've been chasing after it ever 
since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To guide all Umamusume toward happiness, I 
need the power to move many. For that 
reason, I must reign at the very pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That was precisely why her debut should 
have been a long-awaited day, anticipated 
with every passing moment."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet, how strange. Now that it's about to 
begin— the feeling swelling within my 
chest isn't just joy.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well, it'd be weirder if you 
weren't nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: It's okay. You can do anything.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. After all, you have both my and 
CB-chan's stamp of approval."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I get it now too. That feeling of 
wanting to set an example for your cute 
underclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're not the only one carrying burdens. 
Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, thank you. I truly am blessed with 
good friends.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Well, I should get going soon.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, me too! Sorry about that, CB-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Nope! Are you both here for the same 
thing?"

text_block_list.name: Rudolf & Maruzen
text_block_list.text:
"No, I was just asked to give some 
training advice. Yep, just spending a 
little time with an underclassman!"

text_block_list.name: Rudolf & Maruzen
text_block_list.text: ! Huh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha! Go on and catch up to her, 
seniors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Practically chased out by Mr. C.B., the 
two of them left the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was New Year's, so I walked over to say 
hello, only to see Mr. C.B.'s expression—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expression was tense—something 
unimaginable from her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...And. Oh, it's Trainer! Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Should I ask her...? But from her 
perspective, that was an expression she 
never intended to show.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I wondered about it, I decided to 
refrain from asking from my end.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "Whew! Perfect weather for a walk."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now then, where should we go today? Want 
to make some plans? It is New Year's, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"We could go to a bookstore to look for 
poetry anthologies, relax at a cafeteria, 
or visit a shrine like it's New Year's."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll let you decide for once?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—
choice_data_list: Find a poetry collection at the bookstore
Pay our respects at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nice. Well then, let's take our time and 
head out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we headed to the bookstore. A few 
hours later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was looking at the sea.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're asking that now? Even though 
you're already used to it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...And you know, when you feel like 
reading poetry, it really means you want 
to see the sea."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I sort of get it, but also sort of 
don't. At the very least, that seems to be 
how Mr. C.B. is."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. The ocean is 
wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, New Year's Day passed peacefully, 
but I never did figure out what that 
expression I saw in the cafeteria meant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping that one day she will open up to 
me... I want to run alongside her for 
another year to come.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nice, the cafeteria, huh? I was just 
getting hungry, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, we headed into the city to search 
for a cafeteria. A few hours later—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was at Mr. C.B.'s house.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I just remembered my mom gave me 
some kagami mochi.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's a bit early for the Kagami 
Biraki, but who cares.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll go grill it. What kind of sauce do 
you want, Trainer? I'm going with salsa—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, you wanna do that too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after being treated to some mochi, 
we spent New Year's relaxing peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, New Year's Day passed peacefully, 
but I never did figure out what that 
expression I saw in the cafeteria meant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping that one day she will open up to 
me... I want to run alongside her for 
another year to come.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nice. Maybe I should go and pay my 
respects properly for once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, for once heading straight for the 
shrine――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us finished paying our respects 
at the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I ended up asking for so much. I 
wonder if I was being too greedy.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Rudolph is making her debut, right? 
About that, and about Ace, and about 
Maruzen too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that goes for you and me too. I 
want to do my best this year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a slightly surprising wish for 
someone who lived so freely and true to 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, were you surprised?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even I can make a wish, at least. ...If 
it's just making a wish, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, more importantly, I want to buy 
something to take home. I'm starving.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, New Year's Day passed peacefully, 
but I never did figure out what that 
expression I saw in the cafeteria meant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping that one day she will open up to 
me... I want to run alongside her for 
another year to come.
